Global (All).title: US-Iran tensions escalate over drone incident
Global (All).summary: Iran seizes US drone, US threatens retaliation; global economy and stability at risk; potential for military conflict between US and Iran.

Global (All).title: Cyber-attack on Ukraine's infrastructure
Global (All).summary: Massive cyber-attack on Ukraine's infrastructure, including government and private sector; potential for spread to other countries and sectors; high risk of data breaches and outages.

Global (All).title: Protests in China over economic reforms
Global (All).summary: Anti-government protests in China over economic reforms, human rights abuses, and government control; potential for widespread unrest and impact on global supply chains.

United States.title: Roe v Wade Leak
United States.summary: A private memo from Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito has been leaked, suggesting that the court may overturn Roe v Wade, sparking debate and protests.

United States.title: Jan 6 Hearing
United States.summary: The House January 6 Committee holds a hearing to investigate the events leading up to the US Capitol riot on January 6, 2021.

United States.title: Twitter Files
United States.summary: Elon Musk releases "Twitter Files" showing the company's handling of free speech and censorship, sparking debate about social media regulation.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile into Sea of Japan
South Korea.summary: North Korea fired a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan, prompting a strong reaction from South Korea and its allies. The launch is seen as a provocation and a threat to regional security.

South Korea.title: South Korea warns of 'serious consequences' after North Korea's missile launch
South Korea.summary: South Korea's presidential office warned that the missile launch by North Korea is a serious threat to regional security and has urged the international community to take action against Pyongyang.

South Korea.title: North Korea's Kim Jong Un orders military to be ready to strike US and South Korea
South Korea.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has ordered his military to be ready to strike the US and South Korea, sparking a new wave of tensions in the region.

Japan.title: Japan's Economy Faces Risks of Global Recession
Japan.summary: Japanese economy is highly exposed to the global economic downturn due to its high dependence on foreign trade. The risk of a global recession could severely impact Japan's economic growth.

Japan.title: North Korea-US Tensions Escalate, Japan on High Alert
Japan.summary: Tensions between North Korea and the US have escalated in the past week, with North Korea conducting a series of missile tests. Japan has increased its military alert level in response to the heightened tensions.

Japan.title: Japan's COVID-19 Hospitalizations Rise Amid New Variant
Japan.summary: Japan has seen a recent increase in COVID-19 hospitalizations due to a new variant of the virus. The Japanese government has stepped up its efforts to contain the spread of the virus.
